o.text: Possibly a derivation of Proto-Common Turkic *tint- (“to search”), appended with the suffix -dik (otherwise only found in tapdıq). Alternatively, appended with the suffix -ik. Compare Turkish dimdiklemek.
Likely a calque of Russian дело в том, что (delo v tom, što).
Borrowed from Russian электромеха́ника (elektromexánika). By surface analysis, elektro- + mexanika.
